launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.3.0 'Bastion': the UI is now dark EVERYWHERE - the white-backgrounds bug is root-caused (menu-level overlay screens composited their translucent scrims over the raw clear buffer, which is WHITE on gl4es/GLES2; now every menu frame paints an explicit dark clear + a 3-stop panorama gradient with block grid + vignette first). The UI was designed as a web page first (HTML) and converted 1:1 into a new KuiWeb kit (bevel buttons/cards/windows, inset wells, badges, segmented tabs, toggles, glow dots) - all drawn through the mobile-safe Tessellator path. The non-classic mod menu is boxy-beveled and its setting switches ACT instantly (flipping 'Classic Module Menu' now swaps to the classic menu on the spot; a missing option can no longer blank the settings page). Cosmetics got segmented tabs, bevel cards, REAL cape art previews and animated capes that cycle their frames on the card. GLES2 fix: every uploaded UI texture is padded to power-of-two on mobile with a logical UV window - non-POT uploads rendered blank/white on Pojav (why capes/previews were missing). Desktop rendering keeps the SDF smooth UI.
